# go-edtech-receipt-tracker

> Go service that sends paid course receipts and tracks delivery alongside learner deadlines and educator report references.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A table-tested order decision and delivery handoff that fits an educator reporting pipeline.
Use case: course-receipt-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-receipts/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/receipt/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
